snippet.title: Dynamo Kid 3
snippet.description: A new adventure for Dynamo Kid starts here. The Fuzzs have called him for help saving their stars, taken by the wind. Run and jump your way through the many levels filled with creatures, hazerds, hidden rooms and ofcourse stars and SuperStars.
